stem:
Esha waters a plant at its roots. Water and minerals can move through xylem or phloem toward leaves, flowers, or back toward roots.

Which path is correct?

options.text: Through xylem, from roots toward leaves and flowers.
Through phloem, from roots toward leaves and flowers.
Through xylem, from leaves toward roots.
Through xylem, from roots toward leaves only, not flowers.

teacher.key_rationale: Roots take up water and minerals; xylem carries them to leaves and other parts such as flowers.
